observations: Photo 0: front of a black DSLR body with 'Canon', 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II' badges and a Canon body cap on the mount; no lens.
Photo 1: back of the body, rear LCD is off, eyecup fitted, buttons and dials look intact, 'Canon' printed under the screen.
Photo 2: underside plate reads 'Canon DS126201, DC 8.1V, Made in Japan' with serial number 3761814763; the battery door is open and no battery is shown.
The body looks clean in all three photos with no visible scratches, but the shots are small, evenly lit studio-style photos with a dealer watermark.
No photo shows the camera powered on, a shutter count, the sensor, a battery, a charger or a lens.

claims.claim: Canon EOS 5D Mark II full-frame DSLR
claims.evidence: Photo 0 badges 'EOS 5D Mark II'; photo 2 plate DS126201.
Body looks clean in small photos 0 to 2, but no close-ups of corners, grip rubber, mount or LCD, and no shutter count.
Internal repair history cannot be seen in photos.
The LCD is off in photo 1; no clip of it powering on, focusing and taking a shot.
No receipt or warranty card is shown; for a camera of this age a live warranty is unlikely.

risks.risk: Camera does not power on or shutter, AF or LCD faulty
risks.proof: Clip of the camera powering on, taking a shot and showing it on the rear screen

risks.risk: High shutter count, near the end of shutter life
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count read from the camera, with the serial 3761814763 visible

risks.risk: Scratched or dirty sensor, or damaged mirror
risks.proof: Photo of the open mount with the body cap off, plus a test shot of a plain sky at f/16
risks.if_unproven: as sensor needing cleaning or repair

risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with the camera
risks.if_unproven: as body only, without battery or charger

risks.risk: Photos may not be of the seller's own unit
risks.proof: Photo of the camera next to a handwritten code with today's date, showing the serial plate
risks.if_unproven: held for agent inspection before money moves

proof_requests: Clip of the camera powering on and taking a shot, with a handwritten code in shot
Shutter count screenshot with the serial plate visible
Photo of the mount and sensor with the body cap off
Photo of the battery, charger and any accessories included
Photo of the receipt or warranty card if it exists
response.reason: Brand and model are read off the front badge in photo 0 and the plate in photo 2, so it can be priced as a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body only, at its worst case as not working and without battery or charger until the proofs arrive.
